authority.non_authority_statement: This active inventory grants no accepted-decision, implementation, or activation authority.

lifecycle.terminal_handling: Remove resolved, rejected, or superseded records in the same bounded package that records their accepted ADR, canonical rationale, or explicit rejection; preserve history in Git and linked Issues rather than in a second permanent archive.

records.blocking_owner_question: Accept Option A for the Native Character Portfolio / Account Center v2 boundary, or choose Option B or C?
records.decision_question: Which Platform boundary should own authenticated native character portfolio composition and how should it consume Oteryn-v2 Character Authority?

DERIVED: A durable Platform ADR is required because the target boundary changes long-lived module ownership, native identity use, capability/freshness semantics and migration direction.
PlayerCompanion should not be implemented against Canary numeric account/player identifiers because that would duplicate compatibility debt in a new module.
PROVEN: Current AccountOverviewReadModel uses IdentityCanaryAccount, canary_account_id, CanaryGameDataRepository and CHARACTER_LIMIT=10 to derive character creation availability.
Current CharacterProfilePreference stores canary_player_id while Platform owns the privacy and presentation preferences.
ADR 0028 defines Platform-issued AccountId and keeps Canary account IDs inside the legacy compatibility boundary.
Oteryn-v2 merged PR 90 makes Character Authority the owner of CharacterId, current AccountId-to-CharacterId ownership and native character lifecycle mutations.
UNKNOWN: The repository owner has not yet selected the Platform-side Native Character Portfolio ownership option.
Exact native transport, cache TTL, entitlement exchange and Canary-to-CharacterId migration mechanics remain deliberately unresolved.

options.description: Keep Character Portfolio as an Accounts application/read boundary; keep Characters as Platform command orchestration, PublicGameData as public projections and CharacterProfiles as the Platform-owned presentation/privacy subdomain.
options.title: Accounts-owned portfolio boundary
trade_offs: Requires a new authorized Character Authority projection/command adapter and later additive CharacterId migration.
Keeps several explicit module boundaries that must be coordinated carefully.

options.description: Expand PublicGameData to own authenticated account portfolio composition in addition to public game-data projections.
options.title: PublicGameData-owned portfolio
trade_offs: Mixes public-read semantics with owner-private portfolio and command-preparation concerns.

options.description: Create a new standalone CharacterPortfolio module or deployable service for portfolio reads, capabilities and orchestration.
options.title: Standalone portfolio boundary
trade_offs: Adds a new module/service boundary before independent scaling, security isolation or lifecycle need is proven.

records.problem_statement: The current Account Center and CharacterProfiles implementation is Canary-compatible but the native Oteryn-v2 target needs a stable Platform-side character portfolio boundary that does not turn Canary numeric identifiers, direct game-database reads or row-count policy inference into permanent architecture.
records.recommendation: Accept Option A and record Proposed ADR 0030 as Accepted only after explicit repository-owner approval.
records.title: Native Character Portfolio and Account Center v2 boundary
